### New

- **Ultrawide lens:** Set an app's zoom to the camera's minimum, or a custom ratio, to use the ultrawide in apps that never ask for it.
- **Video stabilization:** Turn stabilization off, on, or to preview stabilization for apps that leave it off.
- **Steady frame rate:** Fix an app's frame rate to one of the camera's supported ranges, such as 30 fps.
- **Per app and per camera:** Each app in the module's scope has its own back and front camera settings, and every setting starts at the app's default.
- **Settings screen:** Open it from your Xposed manager to see whether the module is active and change each app's settings.

> [!NOTE]
> **Known issues**
>
> - **When changes apply:** A change applies the next time the app starts its camera, such as turning the camera off and on in a call.
> - **Framework support:** The module needs an Xposed framework with libxposed API 101 or newer, such as Vector 2.1 and later.
